storyboardBeats.narration: Clicking on a turn can point to a CV joint.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Low-angle shot of a front wheel turning sharply into a parking space, tire and wheel well filling frame, slow-motion feel, overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: It lets the axle turn and flex at once.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a drive axle with intact rubber CV boot, garage bay lighting, slow rotate/reveal on a shop stand, soft key light, shallow DOF, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: The boot cracks, the grease leaks out.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro of a torn CV boot with visible dried grease residue and exposed joint, dim garage lighting shifting to harsher practical light, slow push-in on the tear, texture-forward, 9:16 vertical framing
A removed CV axle laid on a clean shop workbench next to hand tools, top-down shot, even overhead light, slow pull-back, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: That noise does not quiet down.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
